filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all specified topics. The selected videos are from highly-regarded educational channels like Neso Academy, The Organic Chemistry Tutor, ALL ABOUT ELECTRONICS, Walid Issa, and تراب الماث. Selections were prioritized based on direct relevance to the topic, educational clarity, and high view counts as a proxy for peer validation. All hard gates and selection criteria were followed.
